provenance: Fresh isolated profile; normal initial starship, zero records. Real pointer dragging and Space bomb inputs guide the ship through three alien formations and the boss. Exact model positions were read only for assisted steering. No save fixtures, state/model writes, direct model.update, clock changes or replay manipulation. This is assisted real-time play, not a human completion-time claim.

videoAlignment.method: Decoded frame onsets matched against the genuine DOM mutation timestamps; 25fps gives a maximum 40ms frame quantization. Audio origin is native MediaRecorder start, offset from the same wall clock. No speed or pitch changes.

anchors.name: launch
anchors.method: First three consecutive decoded 25fps frames showing the real DOM state; matching localized HUD symbol or launch/result button colour in fixed pixel region. Previous frame retains the old state.
